outstanding_research: Source package is explicitly INCOMPLETE and contains an internal count inconsistency: participants array has 97 records while participant_count reports 93.
Waikato Biodiversity Forum and current WRC funding programmes expose additional community, iwi/hapū, wetland, catchment and project entities beyond the baseline.
NZ Landcare Trust 2024/25 impact report says Waikato staff work with 26 groups; those group identities remain an omission-test target.
Central Waikato Predator Free Hub member/cell identities remain incompletely exposed in indexed text and require a separate directory/map extraction.
Priority geographic gaps remain Waitomo/western King Country, southwest coast, Taupō/South Waikato, Matamata-Piako/Hauraki and north Waikato.
